defect: countdown register is written with a blocking assignment inside a clocked block while its peers use nonblocking
rationale: cnt_q is state updated with = in the clocked block, so readers of cnt_q (is_zero_o, cnt_d, the mask/lfsr update on the same edge) can observe the new value in the same time step: simulation order-dependent and unlike the flop hardware.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Expanded the register macros into one clocked block and removed the assertions.

labels.note: A blocking state update can race other clocked processes.
